review_description: Galactic solar installed a 5kW system on our property in Brisbane Northside a few months ago and we have been reaping the benefits already! The installer and his team not only did a great job installing the panels and setting up all the accounts and connections for us, but at the free inspections prior to installation, they also explained to us how many installers are installing the panels in an inefficient way which causes a lack of supply/efficiency to the usage of the panels!. We are impressed at how professional, efficient and affordable this whole process has been!! So if you are paying unnecessary electricity/power bills, give them a call!
Excellent communication and tailored a system to my requirements at a good price. A local small company so able to be flexible around other work being done on the property

The day of the installation, Rob was on time, his workmanship was first rate, he was polite and he cleaned up any mess.Gaelle has kept us informed of the progress and process, from her first contact to post completion of the job. She has forwarded all required paperwork and advised on our next step which is to get the state government rebate.

We couldn't be more satisfied with the decision we made to go with Galactic Solar for our solar system. They were recommended to us by a friend and are happy that speaking to them helped us navigate through the maze of offers, equipment, deals we came across while researching. At the end of the day could not praise Rob and his team more for their workmanship and quality finish.

Service was outstanding from the first phone call to all the way until after installation.Gaelle and Rob are easy people to work with, on time and quality of installation was clean and of high standard.Will be recommending Galactic Solar to family and friends.
Solar quotes Information and referral to contractors for quotes was extremely helpful.
